method: each (shape, phase) runs in a fresh process: N=96 products of the stage are retained and resident growth (ps rss, KiB resolution) is divided by N; phases: body (control), parsed (validated typed request with decoded text), approved (sealed transformed output). Reservation uses the provisional limits: 4*B + min(max_nodes,B)*128 rounded up to 1 KiB units.
provisional_reason: one-minute load average was 73 to 112 during these runs (other sessions plus this session builds), far above 25% of 10 cores; resident-size accounting per retained product is insensitive to CPU load but the label stands
